name: Do I need a U.S. bank account to buy property in Florida?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a U.S. bank account to buy property in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: While not strictly required at the very start, opening a U.S. bank account is highly recommended and often becomes essential during the home buying process. It simplifies earnest money deposits, allows for easier payment of closing costs, and facilitates future property-related expenses like mortgage payments and utility bills. Having a local account can significantly ease financial transactions and avoid international transfer complexities.
